snippet.title: Hollywood Hustle - Game Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
🎬 Welcome to Hollywood Hustle!

Ever wondered what happens to movie sets after filming wraps?

In Hollywood Hustle, you’ll explore abandoned Hollywood backlots, shovel through massive piles of trash, and uncover iconic hidden treasures. Every dig is a gamble, with loot ranging from common finds to legendary discoveries.

⛏️ Dig & Discover – Explore abandoned backlots and uncover hidden treasures.
💎 Loot & Collect – Find loot ranging from common to legendary.
🎥 Explore 6 Studio Districts – Discover different props, loot and vibes inspired by different film genres.
♻️ Recycle & Strategize – Sell your finds, break down rarer items for crafting resources, and fill your bag with matching loot for bonus rewards.
🤖 Meet Your Robot Sidekick – A clumsy, lovable helper who hauls your bags, celebrates your wins, and reacts with real personality.

Hollywood Hustle is coming to PC via Steam in 2025.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4322370/Hollywood_Hustle_A_Prop_Collector_Simulator/

#HollywoodHustle #IndieGame #Gaming #Steam
